Have Compassion on Them Missions

A heart for souls.
A life of service.

Have Compassion on Them Missions is a Christian ministry dedicated to winning souls for Christ and caring for missionaries.

Why we serve

Our burden is to reach unreached people and places with the gospel of Jesus Christ, strengthen discipleship among believers, and stand alongside suffering saints and missionaries in need.

We value faithful service, including work carried out quietly and away from public attention. Our focus is on the people being reached and supported, rather than recognition for ourselves.

Our mandate

Restore discipleship

Encourage believers to make disciples in their everyday communities and help others grow in their walk with Christ.

Revive the missionary spirit

Awaken a renewed burden for souls through going, praying, and supporting those on the mission field.

Reach the unreached

Bring the gospel to unreached people and places, with practical care for missionaries and suffering saints.

Let your faith bear fruit

Share the light of Christ in your community, take personal evangelism seriously, and help others grow as disciples. Whether through going, intercession, or support, respond with a willing heart.
